newsitem.title: ITALY: Milan Bourse FIB30 index surges in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Milan Bourse FIB30 index surges in late trade.

text.p: The Milan bourse Fib30 stock index futures September contract gain over 850 points in late trade to 22,740.
At 1520 GMT, 10 minutes before the close the contract was 3.93 percent up at 22,740 after touching a high of 22,765. It closed on Tuesday at 21,880 and opened on Wednesday at 21,760.
The stock market was strongly firmer with the all-share Mibtel index 2.56 percent up at 14,691.
